/* QuickSight c4bf1a87-c9ee-4b77-9052-f1cfee2076c3 */
SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution"

/* QuickSight c4bf1a87-c9ee-4b77-9052-f1cfee2076c3 */
SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution"

/* QuickSight c4bf1a87-c9ee-4b77-9052-f1cfee2076c3 */
SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution"

/* QuickSight c4bf1a87-c9ee-4b77-9052-f1cfee2076c3 */
SELECT "business_date", "dataset_id", "metric_group_l1", "metric_group_l2", "metric", "metric_friendly_name", "level", "investment_structure_l2", "attribution_node", "currency", "period", "value", "last_update", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with base as (
	select 
		  case
	  		when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and "level" = 0 then 'IPN_TF'
	  		else dataset_id
		  end dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, case
			when dataset_id like '%_TF' or "dataset_id" in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) then 'Total Fund'	
			when dataset_id like '%_C' then 'Core'
			when dataset_id like '%_S' then 'Supplementary'
		  end node_name
		, case
			when metric like '%rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%lc' then 'Local'
			else 'FX'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				  'MRP_TF'
				, 'RP_TF'
				, 'ATP_TF'
				, 'RISK_APP_TF'
				, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
				, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
				/* CORE POOL */
				, 'MRP_C'
				, 'RP_C'
				, 'ATP_C'
				, 'RISK_APP_C'
				, 'DIV_LVG_C'
				, 'INV_SELECT_C'
				/* SUPP POOL */
				, 'MRP_S'
				, 'RP_S'
				, 'ATP_S'
				, 'RISK_APP_S'
				, 'DIV_LVG_S'
				, 'INV_SELECT_S'
			)
			and "level" = 1
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
		union all
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level"
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local and FX values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_rc end time_weighted_return_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_lc end time_weighted_return_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx end time_weighted_return_fx
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_rc end time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_qtd_lc end time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution"

/* cppi::b59081afdc6d15a98a3a51e110b9d95090876c99235dcd6d38d996f04824bd66 */
select * from cmf.pipeline_event 
    where job like '03%model_gen%portfolio'

                 MAX(child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure

                             END

                         CASE

                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure

                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )

                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,                 
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,

             WHERE

                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date

     breaches_under_parents AS

SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,

    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
